annotations.description: Casting Claws of Gix before Arcbound Ravager is suboptimal sequencing. By casting Claws of Gix first, they still get both down this turn since Claws costs 0, but the order matters: if they cast Ravager first, Ravager enters as a 1/1 (modular 1), then casting Claws of Gix triggers Ravager's... wait, Ravager doesn't have an artifact-enters trigger. But casting Arcbound Ravager first is slightly better because it's the more impactful card - if the opponent has instant-speed interaction (like March of Wretched Sorrow), you'd rather have Ravager on board sooner to potentially sacrifice artifacts in response. More importantly, if they can only resolve one spell (e.g., opponent has a counterspell), Ravager is far more valuable than Claws of Gix. Claws of Gix provides minimal value in this board state.
